title: PDF Solutions CONNECT, the Premier Event for Semiconductor Analytics and AI, October 15 and 16 in San Francisco - Semiwiki
gist: Promotional announcement for PDF Solutions CONNECT (Oct 15-16, 2026, San Francisco), featuring customer talks from Qualcomm, STMicroelectronics, Samsung and Intel, a CEO panel with Teradyne, IMEC and Siemens EDA, and demos of the new Exensio Aurora petabyte-scale analytics architecture for agentic AI in manufacturing.

insights.claim: At PDF Solutions CONNECT, Samsung's Senior Director of Metrology and Inspection will discuss adopting PDF Solutions DirectScan to ramp leading-edge chips.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Leading-edge customer adoption of DirectScan is a potential growth driver for PDF Solutions.

insights.claim: Intel Principal Engineer Syed Baquar will describe how Intel is transforming its manufacturing data infrastructure and moving to AI-driven analytics with PDF Solutions.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Intel as a reference customer for AI manufacturing analytics.

insights.claim: Executives from Qualcomm and STMicroelectronics will present projects deploying PDF Solutions' advanced test solutions.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Breadth of test-analytics adoption across fabless and IDM customers.

themes.theme: Exensio Aurora and agentic manufacturing AI

insights.claim: PDF Solutions announced Exensio Aurora on September 9, a scalable analytics architecture built to handle semiconductor manufacturing data at petabyte scale and securely deploy agentic AI across manufacturing operations and the supply chain.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Analytics vendors are repositioning around agentic AI on fab data, a new product cycle.
insights.quote: purpose-built to handle semiconductor manufacturing data at petabyte scale and to securely deploy agentic AI across manufacturing operations and the supply chain
insights.locator: September 9 was a big day for PDF.

insights.claim: PDF Solutions is also targeting equipment makers with Cimetrix Equipment Control Foundation, AI equipment-optimization tools and secureWISE secure remote connectivity.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Equipment-vendor software is an adjacent revenue line.
insights.locator: At this event, PDF Solutions will also present

insights.claim: Jonathan Koomey will keynote on computing energy use, and a panel will include the CEOs of Teradyne, IMEC and PDF Solutions plus Siemens EDA's Ankur Gupta.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Computing energy use is a headline topic at semiconductor analytics events.
